analysis_class: prospective post-preflight-correction author adaptation of a pre-existing MTSA update model

design_history.retained_invalid_predecessor: M8l was frozen and then rejected before any update-game solver because its read monitor had one residual language
design_history.correction_scope: new model family and new protocol; no M8l byte, expectation, or result is repaired, excluded, or overwritten

population_claim: one source-anchored author adaptation; not a faithful native version pair, independently authored contract, held-out third-party case, population sample, production deployment, or timing benchmark
adaptation_rules: retain the source drone landed/air/read phases and takeoff/land/read/blink/charge vocabulary
retain a separately migrated battery component
make wind an uncontrollable two-result action enabled only at the landed phase
define an author-supplied post-event read monitor whose fluent is initiated by read and terminated only by blink
require read;land to be rejected and read;blink;land to be accepted under MTSA post-event proposition semantics
require the same DRONE_READ local state to admit two language-inequivalent activation residuals through read and wind histories
use one old and two new safety requirements with explicit stop/start precedence
use a two-result battery migration in both pair members
the positive second result is a reachable loadable reserve state
the negative changes only that target to a raw-reachable state excluded by P_NO_FAULT
